correctness.rationale: Nondegenerate absolute-trace pairing makes weight-three C_D dual words exactly triples d+y+z=0. Ordered pair intersection N_d=|D∩(D+d)| has involution y->y+d so rho=N_d/2. With |D|=q/2, Boolean autocorrelation A_f(d)=4N_d-q. The source exact Walsh identity W_f(a)=W_Q(a^(17/3)) with Q(x)=Tr(x^3) and odd m makes the Walsh square 2^(m+1) when Tr(a^(17/3))=1, else zero; Fourier inversion and a=y³ give A_f(d)=-G4(d), hence rho=(q-G4)/8. Polar radical satisfies z^256+d^16 z^32+d^8 z^8+z=0, r odd <=7 and quadratic sums zero or magnitude 2^((m+r)/2). Source A3=q(q-2)/48 implies sum rho=3A3=2^(m-3)(2^(m-1)-1) and mean=(2^(m-1)-1)/4 noninteger, hence no 1-design or transitivity. For m>=9 worst possible subtraction 2^((m+1)/2)<2^(m-3). Independent finite-field code independently reconstructed m=5 and m=7 distributions, corroboration only.

final_claim: For odd m>=5 and the common punctured trinomial value set D of source classes (a),(b), each coordinate has rho(d)=2^(m-3)-G4(d)/8 weight-three dual checks where G4(d)=sum_y(-1)^Tr(y^17+d y^3); possible nonzero sum magnitudes are 2^((m+r)/2), r in {1,3,5,7}.
